regions.region: page 3 left Scheme 3 common arrow, entries 2a–2z and 2A–2F, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Thirty-two distinct scope experiments were recorded with shared/footnoted scale, catalyst, AgOTs, L7, solvent, temperature, isolated yield, and HPLC ee. The shared 0.5–24 h arrow range is retained without inventing row-specific times.
Two independent diene-stereoisomer experiments were recorded with 65 °C, 6 h or 24 h, isolated yields, and ee values.

regions.finding: Recorded the 3 mmol scale-up, detosylation, epoxidation, OsO4/NMO/TsNH2 transformation, tetrazine cycloaddition, Suzuki coupling, and 1G analogue cycloaddition as separate experiments with all displayed reagent doses, conditions, yields, and selectivity.

regions.finding: The recovery, yield, and ee time courses for rac-1a, (Ra)-1a, and (Sa)-1a were inspected as three monitored experiments. Qualitative relative rates and plotted-variable identity are recorded; graph coordinates were not promoted to exact tabular data.
The calculated Int1/Int1'/TS pathways and energies are represented as one mechanism/calculation record, not as isolated preparations. Cited SI computational details were not imported.
Two distinct no-reaction experiments with allenes 9a and 9b are introduced and linked to Scheme 10 on page 6, with separate 8a recoveries.
Conclusion summarizes the method and adds no independent reaction record.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left Scheme 7a entries 1–4 and 7b entries 1–2
regions.finding: Six independent solvent/racemization controls were recorded with exact 0.1 mmol scale, catalyst/loadings, 1 mL solvent, 80 °C/0.5 h, NMR yields/recoveries, HPLC ee, and slash source markers.
Two independent component-omission controls were recorded: Rh/Ph-BPE without Ag and Ph-BPE without Rh/Ag. Both retain zero isomer yield and separate 2a recovery.
The DFT free-energy profile is classified as mechanism/calculation; Int/TS species are not reactions or isolated compounds.
The 8a+9a and 8a+9b intermolecular trials are distinct no-reaction experiments with 97% and 98% recovery of 8a.
